scope: Author-paper and official-repository availability review. Inspect only explicitly identified train content; mixed archives may be downloaded intact, but validation/test data bytes must not be opened or parsed.
stages: Freeze official source metadata and identify license statements
Download author-linked archive, list member names only
Establish train identity before parsing records
Census train sources, original/corrected summaries, original span metadata and edit alignment
Export only traceable train normalization if justified, with no invented annotations
label_policy: Do not assume corrected summaries are infallible; distinguish human-correction provenance from local-repair scope. Derived alignments must be labeled derived, never original human character coordinates.
split_policy: Original dialogue groups must remain together across generator versions. Do not inspect validation/test contents to estimate quality, choose examples, or train a model.
